messages:
maria (sec): waking up to alerts  TLS handshake failures from eu-west egress -> service-sidecar spikes. Seen this pattern before but different region. Can infra triage?
devin (infra): Im looking. Noticed a rollout for mesh-sidecar-rbac at 03:04 UTC. Might be related. Pulling proxy logs now.
leah (platform): We also had a semimanual keystore permission normalization at 03:05 to remove legacy principals. Was that the change?
rotator-bot: rotator job rot-20260702-0300 started for service=sidecar-proxy region=eu-west
rotator-bot: rotator: uploaded new certs, attempting finalization -> KMS Decrypt denies seen: status=403 principal=service/sidecar-rotator@redwood.internal
ops-runner: logs: ```
2026-07-02T03:05:28Z sidecar-proxy[i-0a1b2c]: TLS handshake error: remote_cert_chain_invalid
2026-07-02T03:05:29Z sidecar-rotator: KMS decrypt deny signing-key id=projects/redwood/kms/edge-eu status=403
```
maria (sec): Ok likely sequence: RBAC cleanup removed decrypt permission from rotator or rotator key accessor, rotator left an intermediate in staged state, some clients saw partial chain -> handshake fails. But let's verify binding changes. audit-bot, dump the IAM binding event for 03:04-03:06 UTC.
audit-bot: IAM change event id=iam-20260702-0304: principal=ops/legacy-sync@redwood.internal removed role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on key=projects/redwood/kms/edge-eu at 2026-07-02T03:04:12Z
leah (platform): That is the exact change. It was part of the normalization to remove legacy-sync principal. It should not have affected rotator but looks like rotator used a delegated principal that mapped to legacy-sync.
devin (infra): Quick mitigation options: 1) re-grant decrypt to any principal used by rotator; 2) force rotator to abort and rollback to previous chain; 3) restart sidecars after safe chain restore. Which is quickest?
maria (sec): Regrant is fastest. But we need to be careful to not reopen the legacy principal broadly. Do a scoped temporary grant to the rotator service account only.
devin (infra): Applying scoped grant to service/sidecar-rotator@redwood.internal now. command: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding edge-eu --member=serviceAccount:sidecar-rotator@redwood.internal --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter```
devin (infra): Binding applied, waiting for propagation (~20s).
rotator-bot: attempting rotator finalize for rot-20260702-0300 -> KMS decrypt ok; finalize succeeded at 2026-07-02T03:06:09Z. chain state=complete
ops-runner: Restarting sidecar proxy deployment rollout restart deploy/sidecar-proxy -n services
ops-runner: pods restarted and passed readiness probes. Observability: handshake error rate down to baseline within 45s.
leah (platform): We should also look for long-lived clients pinned to stale intermediates (some SDKs pin full chain). ops-runner, capture 5xxs from client LB for next 2h and tag incidents if >5/min.
ops-runner: added ephemeral metric rule: monitor sidecar-handshake-errors >5/min for 120m, alert to #eng-security if triggered.
maria (sec): Evidence and timeline look clean. But we need to tighten the RBAC workflow: any keystore/rotation-affecting IAM PR should require a rotator impact sign-off. Also add an automated preflight that verifies rotator SA still has decrypt on signing keys.
devin (infra): Opening PR: infra/keystore-guardrails -> add preflight check and roll-forward safety net.
leah (platform): Also pushing a rotator enhancement: if KMS decrypt fails during finalize, rotator will auto-roll-back leaf cert upload and emit a high-sev alert. That would have avoided the partial chain state.
maria (sec): Good. For compliance, save the audit bundle and include the IAM change event and KMS deny traces. audit-bot, export.
audit-bot: Exported: s3://redwood-compliance/incidents/20260702-eu-sidecar-tls/audit-bundle.tar.gz include events: iam-20260702-0304, rot-20260702-0300, kms-deny-20260702-0305
maria (sec): Assigning follow-ups: devin revert scoped grant after 24h if no further impact; leah coordinate rotator rollback logic; ops-runner watch and attach logs to ticket; sec to author incident summary and compliance entry.
maria (sec): will update incident tracker INC-2026-472 with the audit link and timeline. Closing initial triage, keep channel notified for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
